mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_history ( user_id, category_id, prompt_type, prompt_text, image_url, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{promptType}, #{promptText}, #{imageUrl}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, prompt_type, prompt_text, image_url, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM prompt_history WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_history SET image_url = #{imageUrl}, final_rvis_pic = #{finalRvisPic}, final_rvis_dttm = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prompt_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(init_regi_dttm) = CURRENT_DATE
